title: Product listing grid with filters sidebar — outdoor gear store
notes: v2 migrates the listing to Tailwind utilities and an Algolia InstantSearch filter panel rendered inside <rl-filter-panel>'s declarative shadow root (brand options re-sorted by count, React useId ids, values now the brand display name). A hidden mobile filter dialog duplicates the brand checkboxes and Min/Max inputs. Product cards become nested divs, are re-sorted ('Recommended') and lose data-sku/data-testid; 'Add to cart' reads 'Add to bag'; wishlist hearts are relabelled 'Add … to favorites'. A new 'Staff picks' rail above the grid repeats the Ridgeline Ascent 2P and Cairn & Co. Ultra Trekker with identical prices and CTAs.
